Welcome to I AM HER TAXES

Tax preparation that meets you where you are.

At I AM HER TAXES, we believe filing your taxes should feel organized, personal, and straightforward. Our mobile tax preparation service is designed for busy individuals and business owners who value convenience and attentive service.

Based in Dayton, Ohio, we plan to offer both virtual and in-person appointments, with clear communication every step of the way.

Tax services for your life and business.

Individual Tax Returns

Federal and state tax preparation for wage earners and individuals with a range of filing needs.

Business Taxes

Good to know

Frequently asked questions.

Do you offer virtual and in-person appointments?

You can request mobile service (COME TO YOU) or an appointment at my location (COME TO ME). Appointments are subject to approval.

Are refund advances available?

Refund advance options may be offered if a participating bank product becomes available. Any advance would be subject to eligibility, approval, and disclosed terms.
